sourceType: Official Government of Punjab tourism website
note: Facts extracted below; prose summaries are written in our own words, not copied verbatim from the source. Harike Wetland here is the same physical site already covered as harike-wetland-amritsar — not to be duplicated.
about: Founded 1596 by Guru Arjan Dev Ji. Name from Sanskrit 'Tarana' (raft/boat that carries one across the ocean of existence). Carved from Amritsar in 2006, 19th district of Punjab. Majha region, bordering Pakistan.

places.name: Sri Darbar Sahib, Tarn Taran
places.facts: Built by Guru Arjan Dev Ji; largest Sarovar of any Gurdwara (289m x 230m), considered a replica of Harmandir Sahib Amritsar. Manji Sahib marks where the Guru supervised the Sarovar excavation. Large Amavasya (no-moon night) monthly gathering.

places.name: Gurdwara Lakeer Sahib
places.facts: Marks where Baba Deep Singh Ji, age 75, drew a line with his Khanda in 1757 asking for volunteers to fight for Harmandir Sahib; ~5,000 Sikhs joined. Gurdwara built 1978.

places.name: Gurdwara Sri Khadur Sahib
places.location: Khadur Sahib town, ~20km from Tarn Taran Sahib
places.facts: Visited by 8 of 10 Sikh Gurus. Guru Angad Dev Ji spent ~13 years here, standardized the Gurmukhi script, wrote the first Punjabi book, died here 29 March 1552 (marked by Gurdwara Malh Akhara). Guru Amar Das Ji served him here 12 years before receiving Guruship.

places.name: Gurdwara Sri Goindwal Sahib
places.location: Goindwal Sahib town, ~23km from Tarn Taran Sahib
places.facts: Centre of Sikhism under Guru Amar Das Ji for 33 years; Baoli stepwell with 84 steps, said to bring liberation from rebirth if Japji Sahib is recited at each step after bathing.

places.name: Gurdwara Baba Budha Sahib
places.location: 20km from Tarn Taran Railway Station, 21km from Bus Stand
places.facts: Honors Baba Budha Ji, disciple of Guru Nanak, who served all 6 successive Gurus and became the first head priest (Granthi) of the Golden Temple.

places.name: Harike Wetland
places.location: Same site as harike-wetland-amritsar destination card
places.facts: Duplicate of the site already added under Amritsar — do not create a second card.

howToReach.note: Bordered by Amritsar, Kapurthala, Ferozepur, and Pakistan.
